teaser.en: Its name means 'piercing', and anyone who brushes against it barefoot learns why.
teaser.sw: Jina lake maana yake ni 'kuchoma', na yeyote anayekigusa bila viatu hujua kwa nini.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'kudunga-dunga', na yeyesi anayechiguta bila virahu anamanya kpwa nini.

summary.en: *Chidungadunga* is a small, spiny shrub of the acanthus family. Its name comes from the way its thorns pierce.
summary.sw: *Chidungadunga* ni kichaka kidogo chenye miiba, cha familia ya acanthus. Jina lake linatokana na jinsi miiba yake inavyochoma.
summary.dg: *Chidungadunga* ni chitsaka chidide cha jamii ya *acanthus*, chenye miya. Dzinare rinatuluka kpwa vira miyaye inavyodunga.

about.en: *Barleria setigera* is a low, much-branched shrub armed with spines. As in many *Barleria*, it has spines at the leaf joints and spiny-edged bracts around the flowers. The flowers are tubular and two-lipped. Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Barleria setigera* ni kichaka kifupi chenye matawi mengi na kilichojaa miiba. Kama ilivyo kwa *Barleria* nyingi, kina miiba kwenye vifundo vya majani na vikonyo-jani (bracts) vyenye kingo za miiba kuzunguka maua. Maua yake ni ya umbo la mrija na yenye midomo miwili. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Barleria setigera* ni chitsaka chifupi chenye panda nyinji na miya. Dza *Barleria* nyinji, china miya phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na muhi, na makodza madide genye miya kanda-kanda ganazunguluka maruwa. Maruwage ni dza mabomba madide, na gana miromo miiri. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni na vitsakani kpwenye tsi kavu ya Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: *Chidungadunga* means 'piercing', from *dunga*, to pierce: the plant has thorns that pierce dangerously. Pakia notes that Digo use the doubled stem *-dungadunga* for thorny plants in general, and this one gets *chi-* because it is a small form. He also gives it as an example of a name built by repeating a word. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chidungadunga* maana yake ni 'kuchoma', kutoka *dunga*, kuchoma: mmea huu una miiba inayochoma vibaya. Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo hutumia shina la neno lililorudiwa *-dungadunga* kwa mimea yenye miiba kwa ujumla, na huu hupewa *chi-* kwa sababu ni umbo dogo. Pia analitoa kama mfano wa jina lililoundwa kwa kurudia neno. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chidungadunga* rina mana ya 'kudunga-dunga', kula kpwa *dunga*, kulumiza kpwa chitu chenye ntsa: mmea huno una miya inayodunga vibaya. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anahumira shina ra kuuyirwa *-dungadunga* kpwa mimea yosi yenye miya, na huno unahala *chi-* kpwa sababu ni mdide. Piya anauhumira dza mfwano wa dzina ririrohendwa kpwa kuuyira neno. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.
